## 1. The Urban Growth Rings (1985–2015)

The cartographic poster below maps the physical settlement rings of **Guilin** across four historical development epochs, overlaid with the high-precision HOTOSM / OpenStreetMap railway transit network:

- <span style="color: #F59E0B; font-weight: bold;">● Pre-1985 Core</span>: Historic urban core and initial post-1949 industrial settlements.
- <span style="color: #EF4444; font-weight: bold;">● 1986–1995 Wave</span>: Early reform, opening up, and Deng Xiaoping's 1992 Southern Tour (*Nanxun*).
- <span style="color: #06B6D4; font-weight: bold;">● 1996–2005 Wave</span>: WTO entry, export industrialization, and new development zones (*Kaifaqu*).
- <span style="color: #10B981; font-weight: bold;">● 2006–2015 Wave</span>: High-speed rail expansion, modern new cities (*Xinqu*), and peri-urban consolidation.
- <span style="color: #38BDF8; font-weight: bold;">━ Railway Corridors</span>: High-precision vector railway network overlaid directly from HOTOSM / OpenStreetMap (high-speed passenger corridors in vibrant cyan, conventional rail lines in silver).

::: {.map-container}
!['The Urban Growth Rings: Guilin'](../output/maps/guilin_hero.png)
:::

## 5. 5-Year Milestone Chronology

| Milestone Year | Urban Footprint (km²) | Growth vs. 1985 Baseline | Share of 2015 Footprint |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **1985** | 76.14 km² | 1.00× (Baseline) | 30.0% |
| **1990** | 95.58 km² | 1.26× | 37.6% |
| **1995** | 121.75 km² | 1.6× | 47.9% |
| **2000** | 141.99 km² | 1.86× | 55.9% |
| **2005** | 171.26 km² | 2.25× | 67.4% |
| **2010** | 208.85 km² | 2.74× | 82.2% |
| **2015** | 254.1 km² | **3.34×** | 100.0% |

## 6. Archival Cartography & Wiki Resources

Direct links to open knowledge, semantic geodata, and scanned map collections for **Guilin**:

- 📖 **English Wikipedia**: [Guilin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guilin) — In-depth overview of history, urban development, demographic shifts, and regional governance.
- 🌐 **Chinese Wikipedia (中文维基百科)**: [桂林市](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%A1%82%E6%9E%97%E5%B8%82) — Authoritative municipal boundaries, administrative subdivisions, and local transport infrastructure.
- 🏷️ **Wikidata Knowledge Base**: [Q189633 (Guilin)](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q189633) — Semantic knowledge graph entity with geocoordinates, OpenStreetMap tags, and linked administrative entities.
- 🗺️ **Wikimedia Commons Map Repository**: [Category:Maps of Guilin](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category%3AMaps%20of%20Guilin) — Community-curated media repository containing thematic, administrative, and transport maps.
- 📜 **Historical Maps Collection**: [Category:Old maps of Guilin](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category%3AOld%20maps%20of%20Guilin) — Scanned historical maps, municipal plans, and early surveys.
- 🔍 **Scanned Maps & Historical Sheets Search**: [Explore scanned bitmap and topographic maps of Guilin on Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=Guilin+map&title=Special:MediaSearch&type=image)

## 7. Data Sources & Attributions

The quantitative and spatial indicators for **Guilin** are synthesized from the following primary sources:

1. **Urban Footprint & Built-Up Surface**: German Aerospace Center (DLR) [World Settlement Footprint Evolution (1985–2015)](https://download.geoservice.dlr.de/WSF_EVO/). 30m resolution multi-decadal satellite detection (*Marconcini et al., 2020, Nature Scientific Data*).
2. **Permanent Resident Population**: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS), [Seventh National Population Census (第七次全国人口普查 / 七普 2020)](http://www.stats.gov.cn/). Resident population: **4.93M** (National Rank: **#15** of 47).
3. **National Urban Tier Classification**: Esri / [ArcGIS Online Big Cities Points FeatureServer](https://services1.arcgis.com/4TXrdeWh0RyCqPgB/arcgis/rest/services/big_cities_points/FeatureServer), National City Rank: **#80** of 184 major Chinese cities.
4. **Detailed Transit & Railway Corridors**: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOTOSM) & UN OCHA, [Railways of China Dataset](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_chn_railways) on HDX. Licensed under the [Open Database License (ODbL 1.0)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/) by OpenStreetMap contributors. Includes full-precision railway alignments, high-speed rail lines, electrified conventional routes, and station points.
5. **Administrative Boundaries**: [GADM Database of Global Administrative Areas (v4.1)](https://gadm.org/), University of California, Davis.
6. **Archival Cartography & Encyclopedia Resources**: [Wikimedia Foundation](https://www.wikimedia.org/) ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/), [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/), and [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/)).
